name: chin-up-narrow-parallel-grip
title: Chin-Up (Narrow Parallel Grip)
primer: This is a chin-up with a narrow, neutral grip, which works the lats and biceps.
steps: Grasp the parallel handles with a neutral grip so that your palms face each other.
Let your body hang from the bar with your arms straight.
Slowly pull yourself up so that your chin is higher than the bar.
With a controlled movement lower yourself to the starting position.
tips: Ensure that your body remains in one line throughout this exercise.
